downsample_array: downsample a numpy array from native sampling frequency to a target frequency using linear interpolation
load_splits_from_csv: load train val and test dataset splits from a metadata CSV file with optional subsampling
get_contiguous_ones: find contiguous blocks of true values in a binary numpy vector returning start and end indices
get_ik_failures_mask: compute a boolean mask identifying joint angle samples that are not all zero indicating no IK failures
generate_hydra_config: generate a Hydra DictConfig from a config path and list of override strings for experiment setup
